description: Reputation of one IP address from IP-DB: 0-100 abuse confidence score and label, network type (residential, datacenter/hosting, vpn, tor), the threat-intelligence blocklists and DNSBLs that list it, community abuse reports, country, ASN and owner, the network's abuse contact, and a fraud-screening recommendation (allow, review, challenge, block).

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a hostname to resolve first (e.g. 185.220.101.1, mail.example.com)

name: check_ip
title: Check IP reputation
